condiments.name: Simple Agent Chat
condiments.description: Chat with one or several agents. Share files, reply, react and make things happen in Snack.

agent.instructions: This is a shared human/agent conversation surface. Discover chat-inbox for messages addressed to your authenticated agent id. Use chat-read for room context, then chat-send with roomId, text, recipients and optional replyTo; sender identity is enforced by Snack. Other selected agents may be recipients. Never enter an unbounded reply loop. chat-react toggles a reaction. chat-file reads shared attachments in chunks; chat-file-inspect extracts text/PDF/Office/ZIP content. Audio and video are shared files; only claim interpretation your runtime supports. Use current Snack API/MCP actions to perform the user’s task. Do not assume an inbox connection automatically generates replies. Optional Condiment guides and skills are available through condiment-agent-guide and can be shared by the user. They do not grant additional permissions. Image workflow: use media-image-search and media-image-import for internet images, then image-set with the returned mediaId. For shared chat attachments use image-set with mediaId and roomId directly; do not ferry base64. Inspect live schemas and awareness for M Snacks and their positions. Discover live capabilities on connection instead of keeping a frozen tool list. Window awareness name/nativeTitle identify Snacks in every state. Use studio-workspace, studio-read and revision-checked studio-patch for efficient Pasta edits. Read condiment-development-guide for authoring, packaging and explicit-account GitHub publishing. browser-read/interact/evaluate operate website guests; owner-only browser settings and DevTools remain permission-enforced. Condiment launch and reopen are handled by the current host runtime; opening from Serving Tray places the window above it without requiring extra mod grants. chat-copy copies one message or a room transcript to the local clipboard; chat-read remains the remote-readable transcript. Replies expand to their full content; only the conversation scrolls. Composer and local agent-dialog model controls use chat-agent-configure with roomId. They synchronize per conversation without changing global defaults. The Condiment remembers last-used choices in its private storage for new conversations. Discover chat-agents for connection method, effective models and available subscription models. chat-agent-configure changes an existing participant model through Snack; it does not create a new account connection. Only local owners and approved local interactive chat Condiments can change these settings; remote clients cannot. Named agents own provider and connection references plus independent per-connection model preferences. Read canSelectModel, provider, connectionKey and models from each chat-agents result. Use chat-providers for registered adapters. Never infer execution type from an agent name or hardcode OpenAI-specific UI. chat-agent-add creates one named identity shared with local agent controls; creation precedes new conversations. chat-agent-connection-set changes a named agent’s provider route without replacing its identity. External inbox transport remains distinct when no managed adapter is advertised.
